The Archives of Eternity is a room in Uldir, located on the west side of the Ring of Containment. Zek'voz is fought here. The Archives is a "data vault" containing a "comprehensive collection of titan knowledge" on lifeforms and chemical compounds throughout the Great Dark, stored on a series of huge, rotating Titan Discs held in alcoves lining the walls of the room. The discs can create projections of the Old Gods and replications of their various minions.

The Arcantina is a pocket dimension that takes the form of a tavern with multiple rooms. Created by an elder mage of the Kirin Tor, it was inherited by Khadgar and served as a place of rest for the Sons of Lothar during the Second War. Since then, it has remained their "special place" and its clientele has expanded.

Arclight Coins (in-game as just coins) is the virtual currency used to purchase Warcraft Minis and leaders, Tomes of Experience, Arclight Energy, talents, and more. Coins can be earned through normal gameplay means and can be purchased with IRL money from the store tab or Battle.net Shop as Coin Packs.
Arclight Rumble Foil Box did not make it out of the PTR. It may have been intended to be used with the Warcraft Rumble Machine.

The Arclight Booster is an optional bundle available in the store tab of Warcraft Rumble at $20 USD. It provides buffs to earning XP and coins during gameplay which is applied for a lifetime on the account, and additional coins. As a player continues to play the game and earn coins without owning this booster, the 50% boost is still applied and added as additional coins as part of this bundle via the Orcy Bank.
